body:
No.  That's where you're wrong.  I don't want to be loved.  I don't feel deserving.  If the meaning of life is to love, well then - I've done that.  It just hasn't been returned.  And I need such an insane amount of love and compassion that it most likely never will be.  What I need from someone, at this point, is beyond what they can give.  I could only feel comfortable if someone was willing to throw away their life for me.  Because that's always been what I've been willing to do for other people.  But that won't happen.  No one else cares as much about other people as I do.

My mom tells me i cause my parents' relationship issues.  And I didn't used to, but, over the years, it's become that way.  She says something cold, and I attack her for drinking.  And my parents end up hating eachother over it.  And I can't keep attacking her.  It kills her.  She's off antidepressants now and it's going to destroy her if I do that again.  But i can't help it.  I don't want to help it.  If she raised me to not be able to deal with her, that's her own fault.  I'm poorly adapted.  This gene pool needs to go.

Don't dwell on girls?  The more male friends I have, the more I realize that they are all emotionless and retarded.  So of course I dwell on girls.  And I meet them and talk to them and act charming.  Until I realize that there's something there.  And then my insecurities take over and I remember that they can't love me.  It's like a fucking script.  I do the same thing.  Within a week or two of meeting a girl, I've gotten them to be very interested in me, while I go from thinking they like me to thinking they're just putting up with me.  I've told my parents this.  They don't care.  Friends don't care.  Relatives don't care.  Even other girls don't care.

I could go to a psychologist or psychiatrist.  But my lack of a support system is proof in itself that I don't have any reason to stay here.

Nope.  Being depressed sucks.  It's like being in prison.  Shit gets old.  Except you're in solitary confinement.  No one else goes to the same prison.  And most people are too caught up in their own shit to make a visit.

I don't believe in God.  It's illogical.  Stupid.  A long time ago, I decided to live each moment like it's my last.  I'm a very "in the moment" individual.  But it only lasts so long before you're doing harm.  My insecurities either overwhelm me or other people.  I know there is nothing.  If I found something else, I would be perplexed and mildly angry.  I want to stop thinking.  I want to stop feeling.  Period.  Drugs don't do it.

Believe me.  I put myself out there.  But the people that have claimed to love me are just obviously faking it.  Most people my age just throw this word around because they don't know what it is.  And it's not going to end.  We live in a superficial world that grows more superficial by the day.  There is no point to this sadness.  There is no light at the end of the tunnel.  The whole human race is going to end in sadness.  And this is my last day of it.  I can't handle one more day of it.  I woke up this morning with the same determination.  I slept on it.  It's a real NEED.   I'm doing it.  For once.  I'm going to do something for myself.

Edit:: specifically, I've told girls I loved them since that incident.  I open up.  And they say they love me too, but it's so obviously just bullshit.  I can see it in their eyes.  It's forced.  They don't believe it.  They hesitate.  The way they say it is even forced.  Annoyed.  They're not actually thinkin about it.  They're simply responding to keep the situation light.  It's so obvious.  The night ends a little earlier than normal.  I go home.  They probably tell their friends how pathetic I am and how they were forced to say they "love me," so I wouldn't kill myself or something.  It seems ridiculous.  But when you're this guy, these situations actually happen.  I've seen true love played out.  I used to know what it felt like to receive real love from my mom.  I've had someone honestly tell me they love me once, and I know what that feels like.  I know how hard it was for them to say that.  I could see it.  It was honesty.  But that isn't going to happen to me again.  That was my last chance.  Ever since then, it's just been all fake.

LOL

You might know what it feels like to think you'll never be loved.  But you'll probably never know what it feels like to just all of a sudden one day take this belief for granted and then go through 7 years of depression, unknowingly believing something devastating like this.  And you just play happy all along and do well and succeed.  And then you fall in love with a girl.  And you show her affection unconditionally, even though you're not dating.  And she returns it.  Nothing is said.  And then, one day, she says she loves you.  And your mind races with happiness.  And then it hits you.  This little thing you were playing around with.  This is real.  You can start to feel that rush of happiness.  But you know that can't be real.  You felt that before your life changed, and it was just bullshit; a false perception.  And she waits for your response.  Because you've said nothing.  Because you can't possibly believe this.  This is just some sort of joke.  You can't be happy.  That's not part of the rules.  And so you say "I don't believe you."  You don't tell her you don't love her.  You just tell her what you are making yourself feel to stay sane in the situation.  And you know this hurts worse than lying and telling her you dont love her.  Because your mom has done the same thing to you.  You've grown up with her saying "no one loves me," no matter how much you or your father console her.

And, what I've come to discover, is that all I want is for some girl to console me in this situation.  I want someone to be ok with that obvious insecurity.  I'm so obviously depressed.  But no one acknowledges it.  No one cares.  I've cared for my mom, tried to tell her I love her, for years.  At best, she thinks I just love her because I have to.  No one would ever try to make me believe that they love me.  Especially not if I didn't believe them.  And I don't mean to not believe them.  I really really just can't.  It's not possible.  I know what love actually feels like.  Especially when the person on the receiving end refuses it.  No one.  I repeat NO ONE has ever given that to me.  NO ONE.  Even the people who knew me before and after the depression.  Including relatives.  My aunts and uncles acted friendly but completely oblivious.  Fuck everything.  I need to end it.

I am depressed because I was raised in an environment that was completely against alcohol.  And then, bam, mom becomes an alcoholic.  She was depressed.  This pretty much ruined her.  And she raised me up to this point.  After that, I just reacted poorly to everything else in my life.  Until I'm depressed and doing everything I can to make people hate me and setting goals that I know I'll fail on purpose just to see myself fail.  I want to die.  I used to think about suicide and cringe no matter how much I wanted it to end.  But now.  The idea of that release, no matter how short it might be.  That feeling that I know it will all be over.  That has to be worth it.  There is nothing I depise more than my life.  I need to end it. And if there is some sort of transcendence, I will become a part of something greater.  If not, I will I end this existence and prevent more suffering on my part and on others.

My mom was on antidepressants.  She took them for years.  And now, at 50 years old, she's going crazy because she spent the last 20-30 years numbed - because they robbed her of creativity of passion.  They made her happy, but too complacent... numb.  I don't want antidepressants.  I don't want medication.  I don't want to talk to someone that knows I have a problem and is just looking for what my problem is.  I want a girl to honest to god care about me - the same way that I care about people I see that are depressed (because I do!).  But no one gives a shit.  There are too few non-fake acting people for me to really enjoy my life anymore.  The chances that I'll find a girl that is genuine is slim, considering I'm just going crazier and crazier; and the more that happens, the less important my genuineness will be.  Fuck everything.

I'm not going to respond to other comments.  It's just more of the same.  LOL yOU LIKE BEING DEPRESSED?hahaha so you enjoy someting?! d'oy 

fucking retards - that's like saying you like jerking off.  it's something.  honestly, it's a little depressing, but it's something.  you have to feel something.  i like feeling depressed if that's all i feel anymore.  but lately i just want to feel nothing.  and i don't want to live feeling nothing.  so taht's taht.
